info.title: Eats API
info.description: Commission-free food delivery REST API. All prices are in cents (integer) unless noted. The platform charges a flat infrastructure fee per order — never a percentage commission.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Session cookie set by better-auth on sign-in

avgRating.description: Average review rating (1–5) rounded to one decimal, or null when the restaurant has no reviews

reviewCount.description: Number of verified-order reviews for this restaurant

UpdateRestaurantInput.description: All fields are optional. Only provided fields are updated.

price.description: Price in euros (float). Service converts to cents.

UpdateMenuItemInput.description: All fields are optional. Only provided fields are updated.

PaymentStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a payment (ADR-006). Only the provider-authenticated webhook (POST /api/webhooks/payments) moves an online payment to SUCCEEDED.

Payment.description: One payment per order (ADR-006). provider "offline" documents direct settlement (pay on delivery) — a first-class commission-free mode, not a stub.

provider.description: PaymentProvider id that created this payment (e.g. "stripe"), or "offline" for direct settlement

amount.description: Amount in cents — exactly the pre-confirmation totalCost. Never recomputed after creation.

providerSessionId.description: Provider checkout session id — set only for online payments

providerPaymentReference.description: Provider's durable payment reference, set by the payment.succeeded webhook event

providerCheckoutUrl.description: Hosted checkout URL for completing a PENDING online payment

nameSnapshot.description: Menu item name snapshotted at order time

unitPrice.description: Unit price in cents, snapshotted at order time

delivery.description: Delivery record for the order, when one exists

payment.description: Payment record for the order (ADR-006). Null only on orders created before payments existed.

itemsCost.description: Sum of all item costs in cents

infrastructureFee.description: Flat infrastructure fee in cents — transparent and published. Not a commission.

totalCost.description: Total cost in cents = itemsCost + infrastructureFee. Complete price — no hidden fees.

PlacedOrder.description: Order as returned from placement. On a node with an online payment provider configured checkoutUrl points to the hosted checkout page; on an offline node it is null and the payment is already SUCCEEDED.

checkoutUrl.description: Provider-hosted checkout URL to redirect the customer to, or null in offline-settlement mode

basePay.description: Base pay in cents — flat per-delivery amount shown to courier before accepting

distancePay.description: Distance pay in cents — per-km rate × estimated km shown to courier before accepting

categories.description: Distinct categories of available menu items across active restaurants, sorted alphabetically

orderId.description: The delivered order this review belongs to — one review per order

body.description: Optional free-text feedback — empty string when the customer left none

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Provider webhook receivers — called by external services, not SDK consumers

patch.summary: Transition a delivery (accept / picked_up / delivered / failed)
patch.description: State machine — accept (UNASSIGNED→ASSIGNED, sets courierId), picked_up (ASSIGNED→PICKED_UP, sets pickedUpAt, Order→IN_DELIVERY), delivered (PICKED_UP→DELIVERED, sets deliveredAt, Order→DELIVERED), failed (any→FAILED).

403.description: Forbidden — delivery is assigned to a different courier or the user is not a courier

get.summary: List deliveries visible to the courier
get.description: With ?status=UNASSIGNED returns available deliveries (anyone can accept). With ?status=ASSIGNED returns this courier's active deliveries. basePay and distancePay are always shown separately — never collapsed into an opaque total (constitution §7 worker rights).

post.summary: Review a delivered order's restaurant (order owner only, once per order)
post.description: Only the customer who placed the order can review it, only after it was DELIVERED, and only once. Reviews are honest feedback — never incentivised, never removable by the restaurant.

409.description: Order already reviewed, or not yet delivered

422.description: Validation error (rating must be an integer 1–5)

get.summary: Get an order by ID (owner only)

201.description: Order placed. On a node with an online payment provider configured the payment is PENDING and `checkoutUrl` points to the provider's hosted checkout page (the client must redirect there); on an offline node the payment is created as provider `offline` / SUCCEEDED and `checkoutUrl` is null.

post.summary: Payment provider webhook receiver (provider-authenticated, no session auth)
post.description: Webhook endpoint called by the node's configured payment provider — not by SDK consumers. Requests are authenticated by the active PaymentProvider implementation (e.g. Stripe signature verification on the raw body); session cookies are ignored. The provider translates its events to a generic lifecycle: `payment.succeeded` marks the payment SUCCEEDED and stores the provider's durable payment reference; `payment.canceled` marks a still-PENDING payment CANCELED, releasing the abandoned checkout per ADR-006 §4. Events that do not affect payment state are acknowledged without action.

schema.description: Raw provider event payload — must not be re-serialised before verification

200.description: Event authenticated and processed (or acknowledged as not payment-relevant)

400.description: Webhook authentication failed (bad or missing signature)

503.description: No payment provider is configured on this node (offline settlement mode)
